text:
Ava: Quick check — planning a canary for model-serving v2.3 tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Target ramp: 5% -> 20% -> 75% over ~45m. Who can own the deploy and smoke?

Ravi: I can own the deploy window. I’ll be on call at 09:00 UTC. Planning to push in the first slot.

Ava: awesome, @Ravi — thanks. Rollout plan: small internal cohort first, then beta customers, then wider. Cohorts: internal, beta-accounts, geo us-east/usc. Keep an eye on token-generation latency and 5xxs.

Ravi: copy. What’s the exact command we should run?

Ava: use deployctl with the canary flags. Example:
```
deployctl release --service model-serving --version v2.3 --canary 5,20,75 --pause-secs 900
```

Priya: I’ll be smoke owner after the 5% step — will validate p50/p95, error-rate, and quality quick-sanity prompts. I’ll run the smoke script and post results here.

Sam: I’ll be rollback owner. My threshold: if error-rate (5xx+bad-responses) > 0.5% for 3 consecutive mins OR p95 latency regresses > 2x baseline, we trigger rollback. I’ll keep the rollback command ready:
```
deployctl rollback --service model-serving --to-version v2.2
```

Ava: Priya can you include a small eval set for quality checks? Maybe 20 prompts that exercise long-context and code-gen.

Priya: Yep — I’ll attach the eval run. Quick smoke steps I’ll run:
1) curl health endpoint across canary instances: `curl -s https://svc.redwood/internal/health | jq .`
2) run 20 sample prompts against canary endpoint and diff token counts/stop reasons
3) check telemetry dashboard (link below) for error spikes

Priya: dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/serving/model-serving/v2.3?view=canary

Ravi: noted. I’ll tag the deploy window in calendar and run the deploy command exactly at 09:00 UTC. Will wait for green from Priya before progressing from 5% -> 20%.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout for model-serving v2.3 at 2026-03-20T09:00:00Z by Ravi

Ava: tiny tweak — add a short 10m observation after 20% before going to 75%. If nothing odd, proceed. Priya please call it green/amber/red.

Priya: will do. My expected checks and thresholds: p50 < 200ms, p95 < 900ms, error-rate < 0.2% for first 10m at 5% and <0.5% on 20%.

Sam: I’ll have an automated rollback dummy in the queue if we hit threshold. Ravi, ping me immediately if you see any unusual deploy logs.

Ravi: got it. I’ll post the deploy logs here (tail of the rollout job) and mark each step.

Ava: perfect — final ownership: Ravi = deploy, Priya = smoke, Sam = rollback. I’ll monitor observability and coordinate communications with support. Posting this as the primary thread during rollout. :thumbsup:

Priya: one more ask — include a small sample split for cohorts to avoid exposing large accounts early. Ravi, set flag `--cohort-filter internal,beta,small-external` if deployctl supports it.

Ravi: can do. I’ll include `--cohort-filter internal,beta,small-external` in the first run.

Ava: thanks all. See you in the thread during rollout.
